# Paris je t'aime

> Official tourism platform for Paris, offering city passes, museum tickets, event calendars, and personalized itineraries through the My.ParisJeTaime web-app.

Paris je t'aime is the official tourism website and app for Paris, providing visitors with comprehensive tools to explore the city including ticketing for major attractions like Musée d'Orsay, Disneyland Paris, and Atelier des Lumières, as well as transportation passes like the Paris City Pass and Navigo Pass.

## Key Topics

- Paris je t'aime
- Paris City Pass
- My.ParisJeTaime web-app
- Museum tickets
- Musée d'Orsay
- Disneyland Paris
- Atelier des Lumières
- Notre-Dame de Paris
- Paris Fashion Week
- Navigo Pass
- RATP transportation
- Walking tours
- Events calendar
- Interactive map
- Cité de l'Histoire

## Core Platform

- [My.ParisJeTaime - Parisian Web-app](https://my.parisjetaime.com/en/home): Homepage for Paris tourism web-app with itineraries, events & services

## Ticketing & Passes

- [My.ParisJeTaime - Parisian Web-app](https://my.parisjetaime.com/en/ticketing): Ticketing hub for Paris attractions, museums, and city pass purchases
